name: gizza-ai/image-resize
summary: Resize an image fetched by URL.

tool.description: Resize an image at the given URL. Provide width and/or height in pixels. Use this when the user asks to make an image smaller or larger, or to fit it to specific dimensions.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to an image (PNG, JPEG, or WebP).

width.description: Output width in pixels. Optional if height is given.

height.description: Output height in pixels. Optional if width is given.

fit.description: How to fit the image into the requested box. Default: contain (preserve aspect ratio, fit inside).
